<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import Home from './Home.svelte';
  import Producto from './Producto.svelte';
  import NotFound from './NotFound.svelte';

  type Product = { id: number; nombre: string };

  const productos: Product[] = [
    { id: 1, nombre: 'Mesa' },
    { id: 2, nombre: 'Silla' }
  ];

  let path = $state<string>(window.location.pathname);

  function normalize(p: string): string {
    if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) return p.slice(0, -1);
    return p;
  }

  function navigate(to: string) {
    if (normalize(to) === normalize(window.location.pathname)) return;
    window.history.pushState({}, '', to);
    path = window.location.pathname;
  }

  onMount(() => {
    const onPop = () => {
      path = window.location.pathname;
    };

    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0) return;
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
      const target = e.target as Element | null;
      const a = target?.closest('a');
      if (!a) return;
      if (a.target && a.target !== '_self') return;
      if (a.hasAttribute('download')) return;
      const url = new URL(a.href, window.location.href);
      if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      navigate(url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
    };

    window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop);
    document.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop);
      document.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
    };
  });

  const route = $derived.by(() => {
    const p = normalize(path);
    if (p === '/') return { name: 'home' as const };
    const m = p.match(/^\/productos\/(\d+)$/);
    if (m) {
      const producto = productos.find((x) => x.id === Number(m[1]));
      if (producto) return { name: 'producto' as const, producto };
    }
    return { name: 'notfound' as const };
  });
</script>

<main class="mx-auto max-w-xl p-6">
  {#if route.name === 'home'}
    <Home {productos} />
  {:else if route.name === 'producto'}
    <Producto producto={route.producto} />
  {:else}
    <NotFound />
  {/if}
</main>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{
  initialValue: string
}>()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'buscar', texto: string): void
}>()

const texto = ref<string>(props.initialValue)

watch(
  () => props.initialValue,
  (nuevo) => {
    texto.value = nuevo
  }
)

const enviar = () => {
  emit('buscar', texto.value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <form class="flex gap-2" @submit.prevent="enviar">
    <input
      v-model="texto"
      type="text"
      placeholder="Buscar"
      class="flex-1 border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
    />
    <button
      type="submit"
      class="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700"
    >
      Buscar
    </button>
  </form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
const props = defineProps<{ modelValue: string }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void
  (e: 'search'): void
}>()

const onInput = (e: Event): void => {
  emit('update:modelValue', (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <form class="mb-4 flex gap-2" @submit.prevent="emit('search')">
    <input
      type="text"
      placeholder="Buscar"
      :value="props.modelValue"
      class="flex-1 rounded border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
      @input="onInput"
    />
    <button
      type="submit"
      class="rounded bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-blue-700"
    >
      Buscar
    </button>
  </form>
</template>
